adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders the serialized `@embedding` without persisting anything (it’s an `OpenStruct` of `EmbeddableHost.all`), and the Ember controller action `saveChanges()` calls `this.get('embedding').update({});` with an empty object. There’s also a PUT route (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`) and a dedicated adapter path for `embedding`, but no actual update semantics implemented. This is diff-grounded unused/misleading scaffolding rather than a user-facing defect, since host CRUD is handled via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` and the template doesn’t appear to invoke `saveChanges()` at all.
